seo.title: Alumni
seo.description: The Softcom Alumni Network invites former colleagues to reconnect and stay part of the Softcom story.

hero.title: You are part of the Softcom story.
hero.subtext: Across teams, roles and generations, people have brought their knowledge, effort and ideas to Softcom. They helped build the company, and their contributions remain part of it.
paragraphs: The Softcom Alumni Network invites you to reconnect with former colleagues and help shape a community that supports what comes next, for one another and for Softcom.
Whether you joined at the beginning or more recently, whatever your role and wherever you are today, you are welcome.

backgroundImage.alt: Softcom people gathered on a plaza in front of a white hotel with a glass arch

join.title: Join the alumni network
join.text: If you have worked at Softcom, you are welcome here. Share your details and tell us what you would like from the community.
